crypto.description: Determines whether the currency belongs to a blockchain.

payinEnabled.description: Determines whether it is allowed to generate addresses for a deposit.

payinPaymentId.description: Determines whether it is required to provide additional information other than the address for a deposit.

payoutEnabled.description: Determines whether the withdrawal is allowed.

payoutIsPaymentId.description: Determines whether providing additional information for the withdrawal is allowed.

transferEnabled.description: Determines whether the transfer between trading account and wallet account is allowed (may be disabled on a maintenance).

delisted.description: An indication of whether the currency was delisted.

payinConfirmations.description: Count of confirmations for the transaction.

precisionPayout.description: Currency precision for the payout (accepted number of digits after the decimal point).

precisionTransfer.description: Currency precision for transfer (accepted number of digits after the decimal point).

lowProcessingTime.description: The lowest processing time in seconds for the payout operation.

highProcessingTime.description: The highest processing time in seconds for the payout operation.

avgProcessingTime.description: The average processing time in seconds for the payout operation.

cryptoPaymentIdName.description: Transaction identifier, e.g., comment, message, memo, attachment, etc.

qrPrefix.description: QR prefix. The prefix is used to indicate the currency in a deposit address.

cryptoExplorer.description: Link to the currency explorer with "{tx}" placeholder instead of hash.

isInstrumentsStable.description: If `true`, the pairs of this currency are displayed on the Stable tab.

accountTopOrder.description: The order in which the user sees the currencies on the Account page.
